[{"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"vulnerability description","code":"reading from invalid memory occurs if there are fewer capturing parentheses than the available space in the external ovector","note":"The bug hypothesis is that the JIT path copies capture slots based on the external ovector size instead of the actual number of capturing groups, so a pattern with too few captures can make the copy loop read past the JIT ovector."},{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2demo.c","function":"main","line":167,"var":"match_data","code":"match_data = pcre2_match_data_create_from_pattern(re, NULL);","note":"The demo allocates match_data sized from the pattern's capture count, which is the external ovector storage later used by pcre2_match/pcre2_jit_match."},{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2demo.c","function":"main","line":170,"var":"re","code":"pcre2_jit_compile(re, PCRE2_JIT_COMPLETE);","note":"Forcing JIT compilation ensures the vulnerable JIT matching path is selected instead of the non-JIT interpreter."},{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2_match.c","function":"pcre2_match","line":6158,"var":"rc","code":"rc = pcre2_jit_match(code, subject, length, start_offset, options, match_data, mcontext);","note":"When the compiled pattern has JIT code and the runtime options are compatible, pcre2_match dispatches into pcre2_jit_match."},{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2_jit_match.c","function":"pcre2_jit_match","line":145,"var":"arguments.oveccount","code":"arguments.oveccount = oveccount << 1;","note":"The JIT engine receives an ovector count derived from the pattern's capture count, but the working JIT ovector layout still reserves extra slots for the overall match and callout bookkeeping."},{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2_jit_compile.c","function":"do_callout","line":7158,"var":"callout_block->offset_vector","code":"callout_block->offset_vector = ovector;","note":"The JIT callout helper exposes the external ovector pointer and then iterates over capture slots to copy JIT offsets back into it."},{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2_jit_compile.c","function":"do_callout","line":7161,"var":"ovector[i]","code":"ovector[i] = jit_ovector[i] - begin;","note":"The copy loop reads from jit_ovector at indices controlled by the external ovector size; if the pattern has fewer capturing parentheses than the available external slots, this can read invalid memory past the initialized JIT ovector region."}]
